name: gitea-connector
description: Gitea workflows for ChatGPT using a separately configured self-hosted Gitea MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Work with a self-hosted Gitea instance through your own MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Adds Gitea workflows for repositories, files, commits, branches, tags, issues, pull requests, reviews, merges and releases. The plugin does not host, launch or provision the MCP connection inside ChatGPT. Each user configures their own self-hosted Gitea MCP server separately in ChatGPT. The plugin then uses the callable tools exposed by that configured MCP server. Passwords, tokens, secrets, keys, user administration, permissions, runners and webhooks remain excluded from the workflow surface. Writes and destructive actions require confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest commits in a repository.
Summarize open issues and pull requests.
